abilities.name: Ability Counter
abilities.textEn: Select one of your Bakugan on the field. For the rest of the game, when an opposing Bakugan uses an Ability Card, the selected Bakugan gets 100 Gs.

abilities.name: Absolute Oblivion
abilities.textEn: Transfers 50 Gs from all Bakugan on the field to Naga. The Bakugan do not get the Gs back until the end of their next battle.

abilities.name: Abyss Ruler
abilities.textEn: Stinglash adds Gs to one of your Bakugan on the field equal to the amount of additional Gs one of your other Bakugan on the field has.

abilities.name: Aero Assault
abilities.textEn: Harpus subtracts 50Gs from all opposing Bakugan on the field. Adds Gs to Harpus equal to the amount of Gs subtracted.

abilities.name: After Shock
abilities.textEn: Swap one of your Gate Cards on the field with a Gate Card from your hand.

abilities.name: After Sting
abilities.textEn: Bee Striker subtracts 50Gs from the opposing Bakugan. Until that Bakugan is defeated, it loses 30Gs at the beginning of each turn, even if it's not on the field.

abilities.name: Air Battle
abilities.textEn: Moves this Bakugan to a different Gate Card and cancels it.

abilities.name: Airlock
abilities.textEn: Select two Gate Cards on the field. When any Bakugan on those Gate Cards gain or lose Gs, divides the gain or loss between all Bakugan on the selected Gate Cards equally, rounded up to the nearest 10.

abilities.name: Alpha Blaster
abilities.textEn: Adds 50 Gs to Leonidas and Leonidas may start or join a battle against any opposing Bakugan on the field. If Leonidas wins, before it is returned to hand, it applies the effect of any Attribute Normal Ability of its attribute.

abilities.name: Amun-Re
abilities.textEn: For the rest of the game, adds 50Gs to Manion when a Gate Card is placed if it's on the field.

abilities.name: Anguish Of The Doomed
abilities.textEn: Vladitor sends all defeated Bakugan to the Doom Dimension.

abilities.name: Anthemusa
abilities.textEn: Moves an opposing Bakugan to Sirenoid's Gate Card. If its G-Power is lower than Sirenoid's, it is defeated.

abilities.name: Aquos And Haos Contrast
abilities.textEn: Use this Ability with Aquos and Haos Bakugan on the field. The player whose turn it currently is takes an additional turn after this one.

abilities.name: Aquos And Subterra Correlation
abilities.textEn: Use this ability with Aquos and Subterra Bakugan on the field. If the two Bakugan are your own they both get 200 Gs. If not, your own Bakugan gains 200 Gs

abilities.name: Aquos And Ventus Correlation
abilities.textEn: Use this ability with Aquos and Ventus Bakugan on the field. If the two Bakugan are your own they both get 150 Gs. If not, your own Bakugan gains 150 Gs

abilities.name: Aquos Cyclone
abilities.textEn: subtracts 100 Gs from each opponent and adds 200 Gs to Frosch.

abilities.name: Aquos Quadruple Chain Attack
abilities.textEn: If there's at least 4 Aquos Bakugan on the field, all opposing Bakugan are defeated.

abilities.name: Aquos Ripple
abilities.textEn: All Aquos Abilities are doubled until Frosch leaves the field.

abilities.name: Aquos Spiral
abilities.textEn: Instead of rolling Leonidas, place it on any Gate Card. Leonidas cannot be affected by Abilities until the end of its next battle.

abilities.name: Atomic Brave
abilities.textEn: Clayf gains G-Power equal to double the amount of Gs the opposing Bakugan gained this turn.

abilities.name: Attractor
abilities.textEn: Moves an opposing Bakugan on the field to Centipoid's Gate Card.

abilities.name: Auragano Revenge
abilities.textEn: Subtracts 200 Gs from the opposing Bakugan.

abilities.name: Auragano Vengeance
abilities.textEn: Adds 100Gs to Hydranoid and reduces 100Gs from every opposing Bakugan on the field.

abilities.name: Backdraft
abilities.textEn: Monarus cancels the current battle, returning any combination of Bakugan or Gate Cards involved back to its owner, as long as the battle cannot continue.

abilities.name: Backfire
abilities.textEn: Garganoid reverses the Gs an opposing Bakugan on the field gained from a Gate Card.

abilities.name: Battalion Charge
abilities.textEn: When Fifth Paladin stands, roll another Bakugan.

abilities.name: Battle Formation
abilities.textEn: Warius allows you to place one of your unused Bakugan on any Gate Card, as long as it does not start or join a battle.

abilities.name: Battle Spirit
abilities.textEn: For the rest of the game, while Warius is on the field, your Bakugan gain 50Gs permanently when they enter a battle.

abilities.name: Big Bang Blaze
abilities.textEn: Wavern nullifies the opponent's Gate Card it's on and applies the effect of one of your Activated Abilities.

abilities.name: Black Is Darkness
abilities.textEn: Moves up to two opposing Bakugan on the field to Centipoid's Gate Card.

abilities.name: Blast Mirage
abilities.textEn: For the rest of the game, when an opposing Bakugan stands on a Gate Card diagonal to Tayghen's Gate Card, you may move it to a Gate Card adjacent to Tayghen's Gate Card.

abilities.name: Blast Storm
abilities.textEn: Select two Gate Cards on the field. Oberus moves all Bakugan on one selected Gate Card to the other.

abilities.name: Blow Away
abilities.textEn: moves an opponent's Bakugan to another Gate Card

abilities.name: Blue Squall
abilities.textEn: Requires Blue Stealth. Preyas applies the effect of one of your Activated Attribute Normal Abilities.

abilities.name: Blue Stealth
abilities.textEn: Transfers 50 Gs from the opposing Bakugan to Preyas and nullifies the opponent's Abilities.

abilities.name: Boosted Dragon
abilities.textEn: Adds 100 Gs to Dragonoid for the rest of the game.

abilities.name: Boosted Ultima
abilities.textEn: Adds 100 Gs to Ultimate Dragonoid and adds 50 Gs to your other Bakugan for the rest of the game.

abilities.name: Brainwash
abilities.textEn: Forces an opponent to randomly reveal 3 Ability Cards from their hand. Adds 100Gs to your Bakugan for each Normal Ability revealed.

abilities.name: Buried Grounds
abilities.textEn: Until this Bakugan leaves the field, when an opposing Bakugan stands on a Gate adjacent to it, roll a die. If it's a 3 or 4, that Bakugan is returned to its owner. If it's a 5 or 6, that Bakugan is moved to a Gate Card adjacent to one it stood on.

abilities.name: Burning Charge
abilities.textEn: Adds 100 Gs to Saurus. If it wins the battle, it keeps the 100 Gs for the rest of the game and moves to an adjacent Gate Card.

abilities.name: Chaos Leap Sting
abilities.textEn: Alpha Hydranoid may start or join a battle from any Gate Card and if it wins, it may start or join a battle from any Gate Card again, up to two additional times. Alpha Hydranoid gains 50Gs permanently when it defeats a Bakugan from these battles.

abilities.name: Chaos of Darkness
abilities.textEn: Hydranoid starts or joins a battle against all Opposing Bakugan on the field.

abilities.name: Chomo Majaro
abilities.textEn: Place two Topaz Attribute Gate Cards on the field. When a Topaz Attribute Gate Card leaves the field, it is removed from the game, place an additional Topaz Attribute Gate Card on the field, and Tricloid gains 50Gs during its next battle.

abilities.name: Chronoclasm
abilities.textEn: Select any amount of your Bakugan on the field. Adds 100Gs to each selected Bakugan and disables them for the next two turns.

abilities.name: Copycat
abilities.textEn: Copies an ability that the opponent Activated or is using.

abilities.name: Cries Of The Doomed
abilities.textEn: Adds 100Gs to Leonidas for each of your defeated Bakugan. If all of your other Bakugan are defeated, also nullifies the opponent's Ability.

abilities.name: Crimson Twister
abilities.textEn: Bee Striker returns a Bakugan on the field back to their owner.

abilities.name: Crushing Bind
abilities.textEn: Serpenoid prevents the opponent's bakugan from gaining Gs from Gate Cards and Abilities.

abilities.name: Crystal Fang
abilities.textEn: Adds 100 Gs to Tigrerra and revives your defeated Bakugan.

abilities.name: Crystal Missile
abilities.textEn: This Ability may be used up to 3 times. Hairadee subtracts 100 Gs from the opposing Bakugan plus an additional 50 Gs for each previous time this Ability was used.

abilities.name: Cut In Saber
abilities.textEn: You may activate this with any of your Haos Bakugan. Adds Tigrerra from your hand or the field to the current battle and adds 50Gs to all of your Bakugan in it.

abilities.name: Cut In Slayer
abilities.textEn: Choose one of your Bakugan on the field. Tigrerra defeats any number of your Bakugan on the field and gives the total G-Power of the defeated Bakugan to the selected Bakugan.

abilities.name: D Strike Attack
abilities.textEn: adds 200 Gs to Delta Dragonoid for the rest of the game.

abilities.name: D Strike Extreme
abilities.textEn: Requires D Strike Attack. Delta Dragonoid loses half of its Gs for the rest of the game and instantly defeats the opponent.

abilities.name: Dark Ritual
abilities.textEn: Select one of your Bakugan on the field. Transfers 50Gs from all of your other Bakugan to the selected Bakugan permanently. When that Bakugan is defeated, transfers all resolved effects from it to one of your Bakugan on the field, including permanent effects.

abilities.name: Dark Sphere Impact
abilities.textEn: Vladitor subtracts 150 Gs from the opposing Bakugan and 50 Gs from all other opposing Bakugan on the field until the end of their next battle.

abilities.name: Darkus And Aquos Correlation
abilities.textEn: Use this ability with Darkus and Aquos Bakugan on the field. If the two Bakugan are your own they both get 150 Gs. If not, your own Bakugan gains 150 Gs

abilities.name: Darkus And Subterra Contrast
abilities.textEn: Use this Ability with Darkus and Subterra Bakugan on the field. Your Bakugan cannot be affected by opposing Gate Cards until the end of next turn.

abilities.name: Darkus Gravity
abilities.textEn: Adds one of your Darkus Bakugan from the field to the current battle.

abilities.name: Darkus Phantom
abilities.textEn: When Leonidas opens on an opponent's Gate Card, you may choose to either cancel it or have Leonidas be unaffected by opposing Abilities until the end of its next battle.

abilities.name: Demon Wizard
abilities.textEn: Select one of your Bakugan on the field. That Bakugan transfers all of its G-Power to Exedra then Exedra gains 100 Gs. When that Bakugan is defeated, Exedra loses the transfered G-Power.

abilities.name: Depth Tornado
abilities.textEn: Juggernoid changes the opposing Bakugan's G-Power equal to the opponent's lowest G-Power Bakugan.

abilities.name: Desert Hole
abilities.textEn: Moves Centipoid to a different Gate Card and changes it to the Subterra Attribute Gate Card.

abilities.name: Desert Thunder
abilities.textEn: Hynoid swaps places with any bakugan on the field.

abilities.name: Destroy Vanish
abilities.textEn: Alpha Hydranoid reduces the opponent's power level to 0.

abilities.name: Destruction Buster
abilities.textEn: Requires Auragano Vengeance. Adds a Hydranoid clone with 200 Gs to the battle for each opposing Bakugan in the battle beyond one. If a Hydranoid clone leaves the field, it is removed from the game.

abilities.name: Destruction Impact
abilities.textEn: Choose one: Adds 100 Gs to Dual Hydranoid for each opposing Bakugan in the battle or returns an opposing Bakugan back to its owner.

abilities.name: Destruction Meteor Storm
abilities.textEn: Adds 200Gs to Storm Skyress and prevents the opponent from activating their Gate Card it's on until the end of the turn/nullifies the Gate Card it's on.

abilities.name: Devils Descent
abilities.textEn: Moves Garganoid to an adjacent Gate Card and cancels it.

abilities.name: Dextra Correlation
abilities.textEn: If you have one Bakugan of each attribute in play, you win the game

abilities.name: Dimension Four
abilities.textEn: Reaper changes the Gate Card it's on to the Darkus Attribute Gate Card.

abilities.name: Dive Mirage
abilities.textEn: Moves this Bakugan to a different Gate Card and cancels it.

abilities.name: Doom Companion
abilities.textEn: Mantris sends itself and the opposing Bakugan to the Doom Dimension.

abilities.name: Double Dimension
abilities.textEn: Reaper nullifies the opponent's ability.

abilities.name: Draconic Crest
abilities.textEn: Requires Omega Eraser. Choose 2 Attributes. Omega Leonidas is now also treated as those two attributes.

abilities.name: Draconic Ogre
abilities.textEn: For the rest of the game, when Ultimate Dragonoid wins a battle, he keeps all the G-Power he gained during that battle.

abilities.name: Dragon Proudia
abilities.textEn: For the rest of the game, Bakugan battling Apollonir cannot gain G-Power.

abilities.name: Dragonic Enforcement
abilities.textEn: Doubles Delta Dragonoid's G-Power.

abilities.name: Dragoon
abilities.textEn: Adds one of the opposing Bakugan's current G-Power to El Condor.

abilities.name: Dreadnought Cannon
abilities.textEn: Select a Gate Card on the field. Laserman subtracts 100Gs from all Bakugan on that Gate Card permanently.

abilities.name: Dual Gazer
abilities.textEn: Dual Hydranoid starts or joins a battle with up to two opposing Bakugan on the field from any Gate Card and gains 50Gs.

abilities.name: Earth Power
abilities.textEn: Place one of your used Gate Cards onto the field. Adds 50 Gs to Manion for each of your Gate Cards on the field.

abilities.name: Earth Shatter
abilities.textEn: Cancels Tuskor's Gate Card and all adjacent Gate Cards.

abilities.name: Eldritch Exile
abilities.textEn: Select any amount of your Bakugan on the field to send to the Doom Dimension. Adds 200Gs to your Bakugan for each Bakugan selected.

abilities.name: Endless Abyss
abilities.textEn: For the rest of the game, at the start of each turn, subtracts 50 Gs from all opposing Bakugan adjacent to Limulus.

abilities.name: Eternal Damnation
abilities.textEn: Select a Bakugan on the field. For the rest of the game, while that Bakugan is on the field, subtracts 100Gs from an opposing Bakugan on the field when an Ability Card is activated.

abilities.name: Exceed
abilities.textEn: Requires Boosted Ultima. Returns all Bakugan on the field to Base G-Power and adds G-power to Ultimate Dragonoid equal to the total of Gs lost.

abilities.name: Eye of the Storm
abilities.textEn: Moves an opponent's Bakugan to Skyress' Gate Card and adds 100 Gs.

abilities.name: Face Of Grief
abilities.textEn: For the rest of the game, if an opponent's card targets Fourtress, it is nullified.

abilities.name: Face Of Joy
abilities.textEn: For the rest of the game, while Fourtress is on the field, your Gate Cards are doubled.

abilities.name: Face Of Rage
abilities.textEn: Adds 50 Gs to Fourtress for the rest of the game, then Fourtress transfers 50 Gs from the opposing Bakugan.

abilities.name: Feather Edge
abilities.textEn: Adds 100Gs to Harpus and allows you to swap the opposing Bakugan with any of the opponent's other undefeated Bakugan.

abilities.name: Feather Storm
abilities.textEn: Harpus allows you to move all of your Bakugan on the field to any Gate Card.

abilities.name: Final Demolition
abilities.textEn: Requires Indigo Nightmare. Alpha Hydranoid applies one of the unselected effects of Indigo Nightmare.

abilities.name: Final Neptune
abilities.textEn: Requires Forcing Wave. Adds 100 Gs to Sirenoid for each unoccupied Gate Card on the field.

abilities.name: Final Wizard
abilities.textEn: Exedra defeats one of your Bakugan to instantly defeat an opposing Bakugan then applies the effects of one of your Activated Abilities.

abilities.name: Fire Judge
abilities.textEn: Destroy any number of your Gate Cards on the field. Adds 200 Gs to your Bakugan for each Gate Card destroyed.

abilities.name: Fire Storm
abilities.textEn: Adds 100 Gs to Skyress for each of your opponent's used Ability Cards.

abilities.name: Fire Tornado
abilities.textEn: Transfers 100 Gs from the opposing Bakugan.

abilities.name: Fire Wall
abilities.textEn: Select a Gate Card on the field. For the rest of the game, when an opponent's Bakugan stands or is placed on the selected Gate Card, it loses 200Gs.

abilities.name: Flare Blinder
abilities.textEn: Tentaclear nullifies the opponent's Normal Ability or the Gate Card it's on.

abilities.name: Flash Flood
abilities.textEn: All of your Aquos Bakugan on the field add 100Gs to each of your other Bakugan adjacent to its Gate Card.

abilities.name: Flowing Tides
abilities.textEn: Redirects a card effect targeting one of your Bakugan to this Bakugan, then add 100Gs to both Bakugan.

abilities.name: Forcing Wave
abilities.textEn: Sirenoid returns any amount of Bakugan on the field back to their owner.

abilities.name: Forecast Warning
abilities.textEn: Delay an Ability selecting one of your Bakugan. Next turn, you may decide when the Ability resolves. If not, it is resolved at the end of the turn.

abilities.name: Frame Fire
abilities.textEn: Falconeer adds 100Gs to one of your Bakugan on the field and prevents its G-Power from being lowered until it leaves the field.

abilities.name: Fuel The Flames
abilities.textEn: Destroy 1 to 3 cards from your hand and adds 200Gs to Dragonoid. If you have one or less cards remaining in hand, adds an additional 50Gs for each card you destroyed.

abilities.name: Gate Building
abilities.textEn: Creates a copy of Gorem's Gate Card under your control and places it on the field. Adds 50Gs to Gorem for each adjacent Gate Card.

abilities.name: Gazer Exedra
abilities.textEn: Select 2 Bakugan on the field, Dual Hydranoid swaps their current G-Power.

abilities.name: Geo Generator
abilities.textEn: Select one of your Bakugan on the field. For the rest of the game, that Bakugan gains 100 gs when a Gate Card opens.

abilities.name: Giga Slicer
abilities.textEn: Fear Ripper destroys an adjacent gate card. If there's a Bakugan on it, it is returned to its owner.

abilities.name: Good and Evil
abilities.textEn: You may switch Preyas II to the other side. Angelo revives your defeated Bakugan. Diablo subtracts 150Gs from an opposing Bakugan on the field.

abilities.name: Grand Down
abilities.textEn: Nullifies the opponent's Gate Card that this Bakugan is on.

abilities.name: Grand Impact
abilities.textEn: Hammer Gorem gains 200Gs and cancels the Gate Card it's on or transfers 150Gs from the opposing Bakugan to itself.

abilities.name: Grand Slide
abilities.textEn: Moves a Gate Card anywhere on the field and allows your adjacent Bakugan to start or join a battle against all opposing Bakugan on it.

abilities.name: Gravity Chamber
abilities.textEn: Moves all opposing Bakugan on the field to Hydranoid's Gate Card. Any Bakugan moved that has lower G-Power than Hydranoid is defeated.

abilities.name: Great Axe
abilities.textEn: Changes Clayf's Gate Card to the Clayf Character Card.

abilities.name: Green Nobility - Soar Violent Winds
abilities.textEn: Requires Fire Storm. Destroy any number of cards from your hand. Adds 100 Gs to Skyress for each card destroyed.

abilities.name: Guardian Angel
abilities.textEn: Removes Monarus from the field. At the start of each turn, select one of your Bakugan on the field or in your hand. If it was on the field, it cannot be affected by opposing Abilities until the end of the turn. If it was in your hand, it cannot be affected by opposing Gate Cards until the end of the turn. If the current selected Bakugan is defeated or if you cannot select a Bakugan, Monarus returns to your hand.

abilities.name: Haos And Darkus Correlation
abilities.textEn: Use this ability with Haos and Darkus Bakugan on the field. If the two Bakugan are your own they both get 150 Gs. If not, your own Bakugan gains 150 Gs

abilities.name: Haos Freeze
abilities.textEn: Places the current battle on hold until another Bakugan joins it.

abilities.name: Haos Lighting
abilities.textEn: When Leonidas opens, any opposing Bakugan on the Gate Card is returned back to its owner. You may select one of your defeated Bakugan to be revived.

abilities.name: Haos Stasis
abilities.textEn: If you have three Haos Bakugan on the field, Tentaclear gains 100 Gs and applies the effect of all your activated abilities.

abilities.name: Hard Shell
abilities.textEn: Terrorclaw pauses a battle it's in until another Bakugan joins it. Subtracts 50Gs from an opposing Bakugan in the paused battle at the start of each turn until the battle is over.

abilities.name: Havoc Tunnel
abilities.textEn: Moves a Gate Card anywhere on the field. Select an adjacent direction to Wormquake. Opposing Bakugan in that direction lose 50Gs for each opposing Bakugan in that direction.

abilities.name: Heaven and Hell
abilities.textEn: Angelo returns all opposing Bakugan back to their owner's hand. Adds 100 Gs to Diablo and nullifies the Gate Card it is on.

abilities.name: Holograph Divide
abilities.textEn: Limulus' G-Power becomes 10Gs higher than the opposing Bakugan's G-Power.

abilities.name: Holy Beast Spirit Attack
abilities.textEn: Defeats Griffon and adds its G-Power to one of your Bakugan on the field.

abilities.name: Hot Blast
abilities.textEn: Moves an opposing Bakugan to a different Gate Card when it stands on El Condor's Gate Card.

abilities.name: Hypno Flash
abilities.textEn: Choose a Gate Card adjacent to Serpenoid. Opposing Bakugan on that Gate Card cannot activate Normal Abilities until Serpenoid leaves the field.

abilities.name: Hypnotic Stare
abilities.textEn: If there are two opposing Bakugan on the same Gate Card, Serpenoid puts one of them under your control, starting a battle. The Bakugan is under your control until the end of the battle.

abilities.name: Indigo Nightmare
abilities.textEn: Choose one: Adds 200 Gs to Alpha Hydranoid, destroys a Gate Card on the field, or subtracts 50 Gs from two opposing Bakugan on the field for the rest of the game.

abilities.name: Infernal Union
abilities.textEn: Select two Bakugan on the field. For the rest of the game, while Naga is on the field, whenever one of the two Bakugan has their G-Power modified, Naga modifies the other Bakugan's G-Power in the same way.

abilities.name: Jump Over
abilities.textEn: Moves Falconeer to a different Gate Card and removes all resolved effects applied to the Gate Card and Bakugan on it, including permanent effects.

abilities.name: Landfill
abilities.textEn: Wormquake changes an Attribute or Reactor Gate Card to the Attribute Gate Card that matches its Attribute and triples all open Attribute Gate Card effects.

abilities.name: Leap Sting
abilities.textEn: Allows Laserman to start or join a battle from any Gate Card and subtracts 100Gs from an opposing Bakugan.

abilities.name: Left Giganti
abilities.textEn: Cancels a Gate Card on the field. When Cycloid leaves the field, put that Gate Card into your hand under your control.

abilities.name: Lightning Shield
abilities.textEn: Nullifies the opponent's Gate Card that this Bakugan is on.

abilities.name: Lightning Tornado
abilities.textEn: Adds 200 Gs to your Bakugan.

abilities.name: Lock Claw
abilities.textEn: Terrorclaw subtracts 100 Gs from an opposing Bakugan and nullifies/prevents the activation of Signature Abilities until the end of this turn.

Ventus: Applies the effects of Fire Storm.

abilities.name: Maelstrom
abilities.textEn: Select two of your Bakugan on the field to swap places. Those Bakugan cannot be defeated by card effects until they leave the field.

abilities.name: Magma Field
abilities.textEn: Place two Subterra Attribute Gate Cards on the field.

abilities.name: Magnum Ulysses
abilities.textEn: Places up to 4 Fifth Paladin copies with 170 Gs on different Gate Cards, as long as it does not start a battle. When the Fifth Paladin copies leave the field, they are removed from the game.

abilities.name: Marionette
abilities.textEn: Mantris moves a Bakugan on the field to any Gate Card.

abilities.name: Maximum Pyrus
abilities.textEn: Adds 200 Gs to Apollonir and returns all other Bakugan on the field back to their base G-Power.

abilities.name: Mecha Mockery
abilities.textEn: Mecha Chamelia transforms into an opposing Bakugan, Attribute and G-Power included, until it leaves the field. Once per turn, while Chamelia is transformed, you may apply the effect of any Ability Card specific to transformed Bakugan.

abilities.name: Mega Impact
abilities.textEn: Adds 50 Gs to Gorem and subtracts 100 Gs from the opposing Bakugan. Gorem Subtracts an additional 100 Gs for every Ability Card your opponent used in this battle.

abilities.name: Melt Flare
abilities.textEn: Requires Boosted Dragon. Dragonoid gains G-Power equal to the difference between the base and current G-Power of another Bakugan on the field.

abilities.name: Merge Shield
abilities.textEn: Hydranoid permanently gains the same amount of Gs an opposing Bakugan on the field gained from an Ability or Gate Card. Hydranoid loses 50 of those permanent Gs at the start of each turn.

abilities.name: Mesmerize
abilities.textEn: Sirenoid moves a Bakugan to an adjacent Gate Card.

abilities.name: Mirror Shell
abilities.textEn: Juggernoid copies and doubles an ability card an opponent is using.

abilities.name: Misty Shadow
abilities.textEn: Removes one of your Bakugan from the field. It is placed back where it was at the end of your next turn.

abilities.name: Molon Labe

gates.textEn: This Gate Card immediately opens upon one or more Bakugan being on it. All Bakugan on this are sent to the Doom Dimension. Put this card into your used pile if it affected any Bakugan.

gates.name: Double Battle
gates.textEn: Forces all players involved in the battle to add one of their Bakugan in hand to the battle.

gates.name: Elemental Power
gates.textEn: Gives the user 100 Gs for each different Attribute on their team.

gates.name: Endless Power
gates.textEn: Adds 100 gs to your Bakugan. The winner of this battle puts this in their hand.

gates.name: Energy Boost
gates.textEn: The Bakugan with the lowest G-Power gets 200 Gs.

gates.name: Energy Merge
gates.textEn: Transfers 100 Gs from the last Bakugan that occupied, stood or was placed on this Gate Card.

gates.name: Fair Game
gates.textEn: This Gate Card immediately opens upon a battle starting on it. Prevents the activation of Ability Cards in this battle and in response to this card.

gates.name: Fair Hands
gates.textEn: All players in this battle place a Gate Card from their Used Pile onto the field. The opponent places it face-up.

gates.name: Final Gambit
gates.textEn: If you only have one Bakugan remaining, this instantly defeats the opposing Bakugan.

gates.name: Final Judgment
gates.textEn: This immediately activates upon a battle starting on it. The winner of this battle loses 100 Gs for the rest of the game.

gates.name: Fly Trap
gates.textEn: This can only be activated in response to an Ability that would move an opponent's Bakugan. That Bakugan moves to this Gate Card instead and subtracts 100Gs.

gates.name: Forcement Wind
gates.textEn: Adds 100 Gs to your Bakugan for each Bakugan on the field with the same attribute.

gates.name: Fortification
gates.textEn: All Trap Ability battle effects are doubled this battle.

gates.name: Gate Close
gates.textEn: Closes all open Gate Cards and puts them under your control.

gates.name: Geometric Ambush
gates.textEn: All players must Activate a Trap Ability from their hand if possible. This does not take up an Ability Slot.

gates.name: Grand Spirit
gates.textEn: adds 50 Gs to your Bakugan for every Gate Card on the field.

gates.name: Gravity Sink
gates.textEn: This immediately activates upon two Bakugan being on it. All Bakugan on this Gate Card are disabled and lose 50Gs at the start of each turn. After three turns, this effect ends, the Bakugan are returned to their owners and the owner of this card gains HSP equal to the Gs lost from this effect. This card is also put into the owner's used pile.

gates.name: Ground Zero
gates.textEn: All Bakugan in this battle have their G-Power set to 0.

gates.name: Hazard
gates.textEn: turns all Bakugan on the Gate Card to the Attribute you said.

gates.name: High Roller
gates.textEn: All players in this battle must destroy an Ability Card from their hand at random, then one of their Bakugan in this battle applies the effect of the destroyed card, resolving in priority order.

gates.name: Hyper Merge
gates.textEn: Transfers 100 Gs from the opposing Bakugan to the user's Bakugan if they are different Attributes.

gates.name: Intercept
gates.textEn: Freezes the current battle until the user decides to continue it. No other Bakugan can land on this card and if these are the final Bakugan of either side the battle continues.

gates.name: Jack'S Trade
gates.textEn: If your Bakugan is Subterra, choose two Gate Cards on the field. Cancel one of them and read the effect of the second, place it back face-down after.

gates.name: Joker'S Wild
gates.textEn: If the user’s Bakugan is Darkus, instantly defeats all opposing Bakugan on this Gate Card.

gates.name: King'S Gambit
gates.textEn: If the user's Bakugan is Pyrus, doubles all additional Gs of their Bakugan on the field, then adds 100Gs to them.

gates.name: Land Pressure
gates.textEn: Return up to two other Gate Cards on the field back to their owner, along with all Bakugan on them. Adds 50Gs for each Bakugan returned this way.

gates.name: Level Down
gates.textEn: The opposing Bakugan's G-Power becomes the same as the lowest G-Power Bakugan on your team.

gates.name: Lock Ghost
gates.textEn: This Gate Card immediately opens upon two or more Bakugan being on it. All Bakugan on this are returned to their owner’s hand and are disabled for the next two turns. Put this card into your used pile if it affected any Bakugan.

gates.name: Magma Fuse
gates.textEn: after the battle is over, every Gate Card and Bakugan on the field are sent back to their owners.

gates.name: Mine Ghost
gates.textEn: This Gate Card immediately opens upon two or more Bakugan being on it. All Bakugan on this are defeated. Put this card into your used pile if it affected any Bakugan.

gates.name: Mirror Break
gates.textEn: This can only be opened if you have a Bakugan on it and in response to an opponent's Ability that creates and places a Bakugan onto the field. The created Bakugan is placed under your control until this Gate Card leaves the field.

gates.name: Negative Nabla
gates.textEn: Adds 300Gs to your Bakugan if the opposing Bakugan is Ventus, Subterra, or Darkus. Adds 300Gs to the opposing Bakugan if they are Pyrus, Aquos, or Haos.

gates.name: Overload
gates.textEn: G-Power modifications are doubled during this battle.

gates.name: Peacemaker
gates.textEn: This immediately activates upon a battle starting on it. Cancels the current battle, returning all Bakugan in it back to their owner. For the next two turns, this effect is applied when a battle starts.

gates.name: Positive Delta
gates.textEn: Subtracts 300Gs from the opposing Bakugan if they are Pyrus, Aquos, or Haos. Subtracts 300Gs from your Bakugan if the opposing Bakugan is Ventus, Subterra, or Darkus.

gates.name: Power Assist
gates.textEn: Your Bakugan's G-Power becomes the same as the highest G-Power Bakugan on your team.

gates.name: Power Spike
gates.textEn: The player with the least amount of used Ability Cards gets 200 Gs.

gates.name: Queen'S Grace
gates.textEn: If the user's Bakugan is Haos, revives one of their defeated Bakugan and adds it to the battle.

gates.name: Quick Reset
gates.textEn: Removes any resolved effects from all Bakugan on the field, including permanent effects.

gates.name: Quicksand Freeze
gates.textEn: This immediately activates upon a battle starting on it. The winner of the battle stays on this Gate Card, cannot be retracted to roll, and loses 50Gs at the start of each turn.

gates.name: Reloaded
gates.textEn: All Normal Abilities played during this battle are doubled.

gates.name: Revive
gates.textEn: Revives all of the user's defeated Bakugan.

gates.name: Royal Flush
gates.textEn: If your Bakugan has no Attribute, applies the effect of Joker's Wild, Ace's Ploy, King's Gambit, Queen's Grace, Jack's Trade, or Suit's Rule, ignoring the additional conditions.

gates.name: Scapegoat
gates.textEn: Restart the current turn from the beginning, except all Bakugan in the current battle are returned to their owner and this card is put into your used pile.

gates.name: Stand Off
gates.textEn: There may only be two Bakugan in the battle taking place on this Gate Card. Any additional Bakugan are returned to its owner. The winner of this battle gains double the amount of HSP.

gates.name: Static Charge
gates.textEn: Adds G-Power to your Bakugan equal to the current G-Power of one of your disabled Bakugan.

gates.name: Strength Sling
gates.textEn: Subtracts 200Gs from all Guardian Bakugan in the battle. If a Generic Bakugan wins the battle, Abilities it activates are doubled for the rest of the game.

gates.name: Suit'S Rule
gates.textEn: If the user's Bakugan is Aquos, changes this Gate Card and another Gate Card on the field to the Aquos Attribute Card.

gates.name: Supernova
gates.textEn: Swaps the G-Power of two Bakugan in the battle.

gates.name: Tactic Reversal
gates.textEn: Swap this Gate Card with one of your opponent's used Gate Cards, put it under your control, and double the effects of it.

gates.name: Tax Ghost
gates.textEn: This Gate Card immediately opens upon one or more Bakugan being on it. All Bakugan on this are defeated, unless their owner transfers 300 HSP for each of their Bakugan. Put this card into your used pile if it affected any Bakugan.

gates.name: Third Judgment
gates.textEn: The battle is placed on hold until another Bakugan joins it. After the winner of the battle is decided, any Bakugan on the same team are forced to battle against each other. This is considered the same battle.

gates.name: Total Conquest
gates.textEn: This immediately activates upon a battle starting on it. All losing Bakugan are revived and are put under the winner's control.

gates.name: Trade-Off
gates.textEn: Defeats any opposing side that has two or more Bakugan with a combined 400 G-Power or higher.

gates.name: Triple Battle
gates.textEn: Places the current battle on hold until another Bakugan joins it.

gates.name: Victory Lap
gates.textEn: This automatically activates upon a battle starting on it. The winning Bakugan gains 100 Gs for the rest of the Game.

gates.name: Vital Exchange
gates.textEn: This can only be activated if two of the user's Bakugan are on it. Swaps the base G-Power of both the user's Bakugan for the rest of the game, and then returns both Bakugan to their owner.

gates.name: Void Field
gates.textEn: This immediately activates upon a battle taking place on it. The Bakugan that loses this battle is sent to the Doom Dimension.

gates.name: Wall Lock
gates.textEn: Nullifies any opposing Ability Card used on this Gate Card.

gates.name: Warp Gate
gates.textEn: Moves two Bakugan on the same Gate Card to a different Gate Card.

gates.name: Wasteland
gates.textEn: Adds 100 gs to both Bakugan for each card in their owner's used pile.
